description: Query Datadog Real User Monitoring (RUM) data. Actions: applications (list RUM apps), events (search RUM events), aggregate (group and count events), performance (Core Web Vitals: LCP, FCP, CLS, FID, INP), waterfall (session timeline with resources/actions/errors). Use for: frontend performance, user sessions, page views, errors, resource loading.

from.description: Start time (ISO 8601, relative like "1h", "7d", or precise like "1d@10:00")

groupBy.description: Fields to group by for aggregation (e.g., ["@view.url_path", "@session.type"])

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (default: 50)

metrics.description: Core Web Vitals metrics to retrieve (default: all). lcp=Largest Contentful Paint, fcp=First Contentful Paint, cls=Cumulative Layout Shift, fid=First Input Delay, inp=Interaction to Next Paint, loading_time=View loading time

to.description: End time (ISO 8601, relative like "now", or precise timestamp)

viewId.description: View ID for waterfall action (optional, filters to specific view)

name: rum
